text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers this morning.
By the end of the year $10 million more will be invested at the Winiary food concentrate firm than Nestle had originally pledged when it bought 45 percent of the firm two years ago.
The Senate on Wednesday will consider three bills passed by the lower house on the reform of the social security system.
The Belchatow brown-coal mine might suffer losses this year of 17.5 million zlotys. The workers council there advises a raising of coal prices.
Wednesday's Wedel shareholderes meeting will vote on the firm's plan to transform itself into a holding.
Creditanstalt Securities has been chosen by British monthly Euromoney as the best brokerage in Poland and Bank Handlowy the best bank.
NOTE - Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
